'''Gilbert''' (Japanese: '''ハジメ''' ''Hajime'') is a [[character of the day]] and a young boy who, in the dub, is the son of the mayor of [[Pallet Town]]. He appeared in ''[[HS14|Journey to the Starting Line!]]''.

He wanted a [[first partner Pokémon]] from [[Hoenn]] like {{p|Torchic}} because they were "special", or a {{p|Pikachu}} like [[Ash Ketchum]]'s, who he seemed to have heard good things about. At the beginning of the episode, he didn't understand the point of having Pokémon other than for protection. He didn't want the hassle of raising them and was spoiled and selfish, making lots of demands for [[Evolution|evolved]] and rare Pokémon like {{p|Raichu}}.

In the episode, he accompanied {{an|Professor Oak}} and the others as they attempted to recapture the escaped baby {{p|Bulbasaur}}, {{p|Charmander}}, and {{p|Squirtle}}. During this quest, he began to learn a lot more about the feelings of Pokémon and grew to understand them. Gilbert eventually chose the Bulbasaur he helped save from a group of {{p|Primeape}} after he was impressed by the strength of [[Ash's Bulbasaur]] at driving them back with a {{m|Solar Beam}}.
